steps.en: The officer opens the common report module
steps.why_en: The module is a separate menu page, not inside the dashboard.
steps.why_id: Modul adalah halaman menu terpisah, bukan di dalam dashboard.

steps.en: The module covers reports and limits access by role
steps.id: Modul memuat laporan dan membatasi akses per role
steps.why_en: Only part of the OCMS reports are in the module; emailed ones are missing.
steps.why_id: Hanya sebagian laporan OCMS ada di modul; yang dikirim email tidak ada.

steps.en: The officer searches reports by date and source
steps.id: Officer mencari laporan per tanggal dan source

steps.en: The officer views the report on screen
steps.why_en: Some reports show rows; file reports only list file names.
steps.why_id: Sebagian laporan tampil sebagai baris; laporan file hanya daftar nama file.

steps.why_en: Download works, but some report tabs lack download permission.
steps.why_id: Download berjalan, tapi beberapa tab laporan tidak punya izin download.
